description: This PHP class defines a Drupal migration source plugin for migrating field data from Drupal 6. It includes methods for querying the database, defining field metadata, preparing data rows, and identifying source IDs, specifically for the 'd6_field' source.

classes.name: Drupal\field\Plugin\migrate\source\d6\Field
classes.description: A Drupal 6 migration source plugin class for extracting field data from the database.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Builds and returns a database query to retrieve field information from the Drupal 6 database.

methods.name: fields
methods.description: Returns an array of field metadata labels for migration.

methods.name: prepareRow
methods.description: Prepares each data row by determining widget types, unserializing settings, and setting source properties.

methods.name: getIds
methods.description: Defines the unique identifier for each source row, based on 'field_name'.
